language_load_failed: This language could not be loaded.
copy_failed: Could not copy: select the text and copy it by hand.
mode_auto_hint: Mines the best Drops campaign on one channel; the second channel earns points on your streamers. Without a campaign, both channels go to points.
mode_drops_hint: One channel, for the current Drops campaign. No channel points.
mode_points_hint: Both channels watch your streamers for channel points. No Drops.
dashboard_no_accounts_text: Add a Twitch account with a code to type on twitch.tv/activate, from any device. No password is stored.
dashboard_updated: The dashboard was updated to version {version}: reload the page to use it.
accounts_remove_text: The session of {name} is revoked on Twitch and deleted here. Drops already claimed stay in its Twitch inventory.
login_waiting: Waiting for your confirmation on Twitch
login_completed: Signed in. The account starts mining within a minute.
login_note: No password is stored. The session is encrypted on this device and can be revoked from {settings}.
login_vault_locked: Unlock the app before adding an account.
account_slots_hint: Twitch credits at most two channels per account at the same time.
account_drops_priority_hint: Their campaigns are mined where “Priority games” sits in “What to mine, in order”, most important first.
account_drops_exclude_names_hint: A campaign or a drop item whose name contains one of these words is ignored.
account_drops_skip_unfinishable: Skip campaigns that cannot finish before they end
account_points_streamers_hint: Most important first. Twitch only counts channel points on two channels watched at the same time.
account_points_empty: No streamer yet. Add the channels you want points on.
strategy_smart_hint: Majority, or best odds when close.
streamer_predictions_stealth: Stealth: stay under the top bet
streamer_predictions_warning: Points can be lost. Keep the stake small.
history_load_failed: The Journal could not be read.
settings_about_text: Open source, MIT licence. Not affiliated with Twitch.
settings_dashboard_password_hint: Set in MINER_PASSWORD on the server: change it there, then restart the server.
settings_auto_lock_hint: Asks for the password again after this long without using the dashboard, also in a tab left open. Mining goes on.
startup_text: The data folder could not be opened. Fix the problem described below, then start the app again.
auth_text: This dashboard is protected. Enter the server password.
error_network: Twitch could not be reached. Check the connection or the proxy.
error_twitch_unavailable: Twitch is not answering right now. The miner tries again by itself.
error_storage: The local database could not be read or written. See the technical logs.
error_invalid_proxy: This proxy address is not valid.
offline_text: Twitch Miner cannot reach its server. Check the connection, then try again.
nav_feedback: Report a bug or suggest an idea
star_prompt_text: A star on GitHub helps other people find the project. This window will not show again.
home_rules: Each account can watch up to two channels at once, Twitch's limit: one Drops campaign at a time, and channel points on your configured list of streamers.
queue_empty: No campaign queued. Check “Which campaigns” in the Drops settings, or the catalogue.
drops_scope_linked_only: Only games whose account is linked
drops_all_campaigns: Ongoing campaigns available to this account
catalogue_none: No Drops campaign is running right now.
logs_subtitle: Logs of the miner, without any token or secret. Safe to paste in a bug report.
logs_load_failed: The logs could not be read.
settings_default_proxy: Default proxy for accounts without their own
settings_proxy_hint: socks5://user:pass@host:port, socks5h://, http:// or https://. Leave empty for a direct connection.
settings_feedback_text: For a bug, attach the logs from the Technical logs page: they contain no secret.
feedback_discord_text: Open a ticket or chat with the community
feedback_github_text: Open an issue: a bug or an idea
settings_catalog_text: The campaign list comes from drops.sunkwi.com, refreshed every 10 minutes.
account_proxy_hint: Empty: the app's default proxy. Changing it restarts the account's connections.
account_mode_desc: What this account spends its watch time on.
account_twitch_hint: Sign in again if Twitch ended the session. Removing the account revokes its session on Twitch.
activity_free_slot: One of the two watched channels is free. Add streamers to earn their channel points.
activity_free_slot_offline: One of the two watched channels is free: none of your streamers is live.
activity_nothing: Nothing to watch right now: no Drops campaign with a live channel and no streamer online.
activity_paused: Paused. Resume to start watching again.
beacon_blocked: spade.twitch.tv is blocked by your DNS or ad blocker: channel points are not credited until you allow it. Also allow the names it points to: spade.sci.twitch.tv, science-edge-external-prod-*.elb.amazonaws.com. Drops still progress.
close_quit_text: Mining stops until you open the app again.
close_tray_text: The window closes, mining continues. Open it again from the tray icon.
close_remember: Your choice is remembered. Change it later in Settings.
close_text: Choose what the close button does from now on.
drops_auto_claim_hint: Claims finished drops as soon as Twitch makes them available, including those already waiting in your inventory.
drops_linked_first_hint: Within the automatic order, campaigns whose game account is linked come first.
drops_order_ending_hint: Mines what would be lost first.
drops_scope_all_hint: Mines every campaign. Unlinked games still earn progress, the claim waits until you link the account.
drops_scope_linked_hint: Only games whose account is linked to Twitch, so every drop can be claimed.
drops_skip_hint: Ignores a campaign when there is not enough time left to finish it.
error_unknown_channel: No Twitch channel has this name.
error_device_code_pending: The code is not confirmed on Twitch yet.
error_invalid_vault: The saved sessions are damaged. Sign in again.
error_invalid_streamer_login: This is not a valid Twitch login.
error_passphrase_required: Set an app password before locking the app.
error_notification_failed: The notification could not be sent. See the technical logs.
error_catalog_rate_limited: The catalogue asked to slow down. The next refresh waits longer.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong passwords: try again in a moment.
error_https_required: Open the dashboard at its HTTPS address.
error_forwarded_for_required: The HTTPS proxy in front of the dashboard must send the visitor's address (X-Forwarded-For).
error_proxy_not_local: The dashboard only accepts its HTTPS proxy from this machine or its local network.
error_cross_site_request: Refused: the request came from a page of another site.
error_update_signature_refused: The download does not match the release's signature: nothing was installed.
error_update_install_failed: The update could not be installed: the app stays on its current version.
error_dashboard_unauthorized: Your dashboard session ended. Sign in again.
error_invalid_request: The request was refused as invalid.
lock_unsaved_text: The changes you have not saved will be lost.
login_step_check: Check that Twitch shows this code, then confirm
login_step_open_hint: The link already contains the code. Sign in with the account to add.
overview_no_campaign: No Drops campaign is being mined right now.
points_streak_priority_hint: Watches first the streamers whose watch streak is at stake: a streak about to expire, a streak to recover after missed streams, and the streak bonus at the start of each new live. Only for the points channel, never for the Drops one.
security_on_text: The app opens locked: your password unlocks it and decrypts the Twitch sessions. Without it, nothing mines.
security_off_text: Anyone using this computer can open the app. Set a password to lock it at launch and encrypt the Twitch sessions with it.
security_rules: At least 4 characters. It cannot be recovered: if you lose it, add the accounts again.
security_access_local: Over plain HTTP: keep this dashboard on your own network, or put it behind an HTTPS reverse proxy with MINER_PUBLIC_URL.
security_access_public: Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, at {host}.
slots_two_hint: The most Twitch credits per account: one for Drops, one for points, or two for points.
slots_one_hint: Quieter: a single channel at a time.
streamer_claim_bonus_hint: Claims the bonus chest that appears every 15 minutes.
streamer_claim_moments_hint: Claims moment badges when the streamer starts one.
streamer_follow_raids_hint: Follows the streamer when they raid another channel.
streamer_predictions_stealth_hint: Never bets more than the current top bettor.
streamer_watch_streak_hint: Counts for the watch streaks priority: a new live, a streak about to expire or one to recover puts this streamer first.
ev_watch_points_streak_at_risk: Watching {channel} for channel points (streak at risk)
ev_session_expired: Twitch session expired: sign in again
drops_exclude_names_placeholder: A word from a campaign or item name…
catalogue_intro: All Twitch Drops campaigns, refreshed every 10 minutes from {site}.
campaign_prioritized: Placed at the top of the mining order
queue_hint: Drag to choose the order. New campaigns are placed automatically, following “What to mine, in order” in the account settings.
ignored_hint: Campaigns and items this account never mines.
login_setup_copy_hint: Copies the chosen account's settings as they are (the mining order of Drops campaigns, exclusions, the streamer list), except the proxy.
error_not_supported: Not available in this version of the app.
bulk_hint: The changes made on {name} ({count}) are made again on the ticked accounts. Each account keeps the rest of its settings.
copy_drops_hint: Replaces the Drops settings of {name}: mining order, priorities, exclusions, scope and claiming.
copy_points_hint: Replaces the streamers of {name}, with the options of each one, the default options for new streamers and the priorities.
import_no_account: No other account to copy from.
import_none_new: Nothing new: these channels are already in the list.
import_paste_placeholder: One name per line, or separated by commas or spaces. @names and twitch.tv links work too.
login_setup_later_hint: The account stays paused until you start it, now or later from its page.
login_setup_streamers_empty: No streamer yet: add some below, or later from the Points page.
login_setup_streamers_hint: The channels this account watches for channel points, most important first.
streamer_search_hint: Type the channel name, then search: its options show once it is found.
drops_mine_points_hint: On the channel watched for Drops: its bonus chests are claimed and its points show in the journal.
drops_points_followed_only_hint: Channel points are earned only when the account follows the channel.
streamer_chat_hint: The account shows among the chat's viewers, never writing. It does not change Twitch channel points.
settings_start_minimized_hint: The window stays hidden at start; open it from the tray icon.
settings_data_folder_hint: Accounts, settings, history and logs are stored here.
updates_available_locked: Version {version} is available. Unlock the app to install it.
updates_pull_image: To update, pull the new image, then restart the container:
updates_check_failed: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
updates_never_checked: Last checked: no answer yet since the start
updates_confirm_text: You have version {current}. The app downloads version {version}, stops mining on every account, installs it and restarts by itself. Mining then starts again on its own.
updates_restarting: Installing version {version}. The app restarts by itself.
updates_install_failed: The update could not be installed. Try again later.
updates_failed_restarted: Version {version} could not be installed: the app restarted on its current version.
updates_download_failed: The download stopped. Check your connection and try again.
updates_interval_hint: The app also checks when it starts. It never installs by itself: a new version is offered here.
updates_interval_hint_server: The server also checks when it starts. It never updates itself: a new version is shown here and in the journal.
streamer_community_goals_hint: Gives channel points to the streamer's community goals while live: as much as the goal still needs, within the limit per viewer and the balance.
streamer_predictions_filter_hint: Skips the bet when the condition on the chosen side is not met.
streamer_predictions_gap_hint: Smart follows the majority unless the two sides are this close, then it takes the best odds.
account_state_running_hint: The account mines with its settings. Pausing stops everything: Drops, channel points and chat.
account_state_paused_hint: The account is paused: it watches nothing and earns nothing. Its settings are kept.
nav_account_reorder_hint: Drag, or Alt + arrows, to reorder
chat_online_hint: Joins the chat while the stream is live.
chat_always_hint: Stays in the chat, live or not.
chat_offline_hint: Joins the chat only while the channel is offline.
chat_never_hint: Never joins the chat: no channel points and no watch streak are lost.
login_setup_start_hint: Start from the default settings, or reuse the settings of an account you already mine with. You can change anything in the next steps.
login_setup_summary_hint: Everything can be changed later from the account's pages.
login_setup_drops_hint: Which campaigns this account mines, and whether it claims the rewards itself.
inventory_hint: The rewards of your Drops campaigns, read from your Twitch inventory. A reward is claimed here when automatic claiming is off.
inventory_waiting_link: Waiting for the game account link
inventory_paused: The account is paused: its Twitch inventory is read while it runs.
notify_test_detail: Twitch Miner can reach this target. A claimed drop looks like this. Every name and picture in this message is a test.
copy_drops_from_account: Copy the Drops setup of another account
copy_points_from_account: Copy the streamers of another account
import_entry_unchecked: Twitch did not answer for this channel
import_entry_invalid: Not a name or a twitch.tv link
badge_hint_mining_drops: Watching a channel for a Drops campaign
badge_hint_mining_badges: Watching a channel for a badge
badge_hint_mining: Running, looking for a channel to watch
badge_hint_login_required: Twitch ended the session: sign in again
badge_hint_reason_ordered: Placed by hand in the mining order
badge_hint_reason_ending_soon: Ends soon, so it goes first
badge_hint_reason_lowest_remaining: Few minutes left, so it is finished first
badge_hint_blocked_no_live: None of its channels is live
badge_hint_blocked_one_at_a_time: Only one campaign is mined at a time
badge_hint_blocked_no_drop: Twitch offers no drop to earn yet
badge_hint_linked: Game account linked: the drops can be claimed
badge_hint_not_linked: Link the game account to claim the drops
badge_hint_ready: Earned: it only needs to be claimed
badge_hint_item: Arrives in the game once claimed
badge_hint_watching: This account watches the channel right now
badge_hint_streak_risk: The watch streak on this channel is about to break
badge_hint_in_progress: Twitch counts your minutes for this campaign
confirm_remove_streamer_text: {name} will no longer be watched by this account for channel points, and its options are lost.
confirm_remove_game_text: {name} is still mined, but its campaigns no longer go before the others.
confirm_remove_excluded_game_text: {name} can be mined again: its campaigns are no longer skipped.
confirm_remove_excluded_word_text: Campaigns and drop items whose name contains {name} are no longer ignored.
confirm_remove_setup_streamer_text: {name} leaves the list: this account will not watch it for channel points.
drops_add_game_hint: Search for a game as on Twitch. Games with Drops running come first.
points_subscriber_priority_hint: Twitch gives more points per minute on channels where this account is subscribed (×1.2 to ×2 depending on the tier): they come before the rest of your list.
drops_streamers_first_hint: For a campaign, a channel of your list streaming the right game with Drops comes before an unknown channel: Drops and points in the same place.
change_streamer_defaults: Default options for new streamers saved successfully
bet_timing_at_open_hint: Bets as soon as voting opens: the strategies have little data then.
bet_timing_before_close_hint: Bets the chosen number of seconds before voting ends.
bet_timing_percent: After a percentage of the voting time
bet_timing_percent_hint: Bets once this percentage of the voting time has passed: 50 % = halfway, 90 % = just before the end.
points_reason_streak_bonus_hint: Watched until Twitch pays the streak bonus of this new live, for a few minutes at most
points_reason_streak_at_risk_hint: Watched first to keep its watch streak
points_reason_subscribed_hint: Watched first: the account is subscribed and Twitch gives it more points
points_reason_list_order_hint: Watched in the order of the streamer list
points_streamer_defaults_hint: A streamer added (by hand, by import or during the setup) starts with these options.
points_group_hint: Only the options you change apply to these streamers; an option marked “Mixed” keeps each one's own value until you change it.

match.countPlural=one: Also use this option by default for new streamers?
match.countPlural=*: Also use these options by default for new streamers?

match.countPlural=one: New streamers will start with the value you just chose for this option; you can change it in Account settings.
match.countPlural=*: New streamers will start with the values you just chose for these options; you can change them in Account settings.

requests_subtitle: Requests sent to Twitch and the other services, without any token or secret. Failures are kept one by one, the others counted per 10 minutes, as long as the journal.
requests_load_failed: The requests could not be read.
spam_search_hint: Search any Twitch channel, even one outside your Points list.
spam_pick_text: Its custom rewards show here, with this account's balance on the channel.
spam_balance_unlimited: Unlimited channel points: Twitch takes none on your own channel
spam_balance_live_hint: Read again every 2 to 3 s while this page is open. The time is the balance's last change.
spam_balance_paused_hint: The balance is read again as soon as the window has the focus.
spam_balance_failing_hint: The last reads of the balance failed. It is read again every 2 to 3 s.
spam_delay_hint: Between two redemptions of one burst, 0 to 5,000 ms.
spam_load_failed: The rewards could not be read
spam_hint_disabled: Disabled by the channel: it does not show on Twitch.
spam_hint_paused: Paused by the channel during this stream.
spam_hint_out_of_stock: Limit reached for this stream or for you.
error_unknown_reward: This reward is no longer on the channel.
error_reward_not_redeemable: Nothing was sent: the reward needs a message, is unavailable or on cooldown, or the balance is too low.
error_burst_running: This reward is still being sent: wait for it to finish.
spam_result_lost: No result came back for {reward}: the Journal shows what was sent.
badges_intro: Every global chat badge Twitch lists and how to get it, from {site}.
badges_none: The badge list has not been read yet.
badge_hint_badge_minable: Watch time only: the miner can get it
mining_order_hint: Drag the rows to choose what is mined first. A row that is switched off is not mined, except the campaigns you placed yourself in the mining order.
mining_lane_priority_games_hint: The campaigns of your priority games, in the list's order.
mining_lane_badges_hint: Drops campaigns that give a badge the account does not have yet, and Twitch quests. Watch time only.
badge_hint_reason_badge: Gives a badge the account does not have yet
badge_hint_quest: A Twitch event: any channel of its categories counts
account_badges_not_read: The account's badges and quests are read while it runs.
account_badges_order_hint: Drag to choose which badge to mine first. This is the same order as on the Drops tab.
account_badges_order_empty: No badge to mine for now.
drops_selection_only_hint: Mines only your priority games and the campaigns marked with a star. Once all of them are mined, no other campaign is started.
badges_selection_only_hint: Mines only the badges marked with a star. Once all of them are mined, no other badge is started.
badges_not_selected_hint: “Only my selection” is on: mark this badge with a star to mine it.
account_badges_mining_off: Badges are switched off in this account's “What to mine, in order”: they are shown, not mined.
account_badges_empty_owned: This account has no global badge yet.
badge_hint_quest_not_minable: Twitch names no category or channel the miner can watch for it
account_badges_not_mined_hint: Shown, never mined: a subscription is needed, or Twitch names no channel the miner can watch.
